in_latin.name: Brig
in_latin.meaning: Strong and powerful, possibly derived from Celtic or Germanic roots
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen fortis et potentis, fortasse de radicibus Celtica vel Germanica derivatum. In linguam Latinam, Brig significat 'fortis' vel 'potens', quod multum in Christianis traditionibus significat fortitudinem spiritualem et fidem. In cultura Christiana, nomen Brig potest referre ad fortitudinem, virtutem, et perseverantiam in fide et amore Dei.
